task: Add integration tests for AWS Integration entity lists' cursor/nextToken 'Load more' pagination across five entity types, using a novel two-stage mock re-registration technique, with zero production code changes.

key_reasoning.reason: Test surface spans AwsEntityList.tsx (shared render/state component), awsVendorStore.getVendorEntities (store action), 5 page wrappers (Agents/Flows/Knowledge Bases/Guardrails/AgentCore Runtimes) with a routing split (4 use mocked useVueRouter, 1 uses real react-router useParams), plus a direct import of requestRegistry (test-infra shared utility) to work around its query-string-blind keying -- bumped to XL by the core-shared-utilities red flag.

Acceptance criteria 1-4 are individually well-specified, but the task description's stated test directory (`_tests_`, single underscore) conflicts with the actual vitest.workspace.ts integration discovery glob (`__tests__`, double underscore) -- a factual defect that must be resolved before writing any file or the suite silently discovers zero tests.

No existing integration-level precedent for cursor/nextToken pagination combined with mockAPI anywhere in the codebase; requestRegistry is keyed only by method:url (query string excluded), so simulating page-1-then-page-2 on the same URL requires inventing a new two-stage re-registration technique from first principles -- a genuinely novel approach with no exact precedent to copy.
